questions.title: Energy carrier and food bar
questions.issue: You are considering Zhelvek for the general energy carrier, with Velvek or Velzhel for the food. This is still a choice, not a settled replacement.
questions.recommended_handling: Confirm whether Zhelvek keeps the general meaning and choose the food name. Compare both candidates before adding one.

questions.title: Sanctuary or sanctuary member
questions.issue: Shalor-in is explained as a person belonging to the sanctuary, but the example still translates it as the sanctuary itself.
questions.recommended_handling: Use Shalor in this place-based example. Record the participant meaning of -in separately while preserving its existing plural function.

questions.title: Possession versus without
questions.issue: F050 says pronoun + ka + noun indicates possession, while F091 translates Var I ka shal as I go without light. The same pattern meets both descriptions.
questions.recommended_handling: Keep the established without example. Explain that context can distinguish the spaced possessive construction; do not use pronoun adjacency as an absolute rule. Confirm that ambiguity is intended.

questions.title: Additional endings
questions.issue: Varan is explained with continuous -an, but the current dictionary records -al as continuous. The new Kora example uses kelvor-ian for their mouth, but no -ian rule is recorded in the checked morphology or grammar tables.
questions.recommended_handling: Decide whether -an is an accepted alternative to -al. For kelvor-ian, supply the intended possessive rule or use the established possessive construction.

questions.title: Duration versus night
questions.issue: The proposed meaning of Noral is duration or passing time. All three flagged examples translate it as night. Adding the proposed entry alone leaves the mismatch.
questions.recommended_handling: Choose whether the examples should describe duration, or whether they should retain night and use a different Celan form.

questions.title: Time versus city
questions.issue: Nor-var I nor Varthas uses temporal nor immediately before city. The proposed English adds an appointed time and in the city, which are not separately expressed in the Celan.
questions.recommended_handling: If the intended sentence is I will go to the city, change it to Nor-var I an Varthas. Otherwise provide the intended time phrase.

questions.title: The family disappears
questions.issue: The two proposed ritual corrections replace thal Tharvok with an thal. That removes the family word, but both English translations still mention family.
questions.recommended_handling: Retain an explicit family phrase when rebuilding these sentences. Preserve the newer F048 corrections on the two overlapping grain/storm examples.

questions.title: Tent or home
questions.issue: You establish Teremil as home and Emil as food. The remaining example is rinaen teremil kalbelrin, translated The tent is canvas. You mention a possible tent meaning without clearly approving it.
questions.recommended_handling: Translate this as The home is made of canvas, preserving the existing meanings. Create a tent sense only if you explicitly want it.

questions.title: Lianeth labels
questions.issue: F005 specifies Modal, while F032 says Modal / Verb for ability and adds an Adjective sense. It is unclear whether Verb should remain a separate label.
questions.recommended_handling: Use Modal for can/able to and Adjective for reliable/sound/dependable. Keep Verb only if you intend a distinct verb use.

questions.title: Word meanings versus explanations of their parts
questions.issue: Several new entries have clear proposed meanings but explain their parts using meanings or endings not established in the current app. For example, Velk currently means ice/frozen water, while the Velkrel explanation calls it cool air; -rel is described as breeze/soft flow without a standalone recorded suffix.
questions.recommended_handling: Treat each word meaning separately from its derivation. Verify explanations against the app and keep unsupported derivations pending rather than silently adding general root or suffix meanings.
